definition_used: One or more journals/publishers misunderstood one or more parts of a message sent to and/or from one or more journals/publishers.
caution: Miscommunication is a process error within journal/publisher operations, not directly about research content or authorship. It may affect editorial governance and transparency, but is often a status/notice issue rather than a substantive manuscript flaw.
semantic_rationale: The definition describes a misunderstanding involving journal/publisher communication, which is an internal editorial process error (editorial_peer_review_governance) and can impact post-publication transparency (post_publication_transparency_due_process_oversight). It does not inherently concern research content reliability or authorship integrity.
